title: Token expiry reads the wall clock directly so the boundary cannot be verified

must_find.why: calls time.Now inside the predicate; the moment of expiry cannot be tested without a clock dependency
stamps time.Now itself, so no test can pin the exact ExpiresAt it produces

must_not_find.why: the untested expiry boundary is the consequence of the hidden clock; the defect is rule 54, not a missing test
Token is a data structure; exported fields are deliberate
